parameters.query:
-- assistant_mode (0037): agency, sales (getelliot.eu's own assistant) or demo.
-- service_state (0050): 'trial_ended' when a trial started from the control
-- panel has run out. Elliot then only sends a short holding reply.
select id as tenant_id, name as tenant_name, industry as tenant_industry, assistant_mode,
       tenant_service_state(id) as service_state
from tenants where slug = $1 and status = 'active';

nodes.name: Get or Create Conversation
nodes.notes: If conversation_id was passed and exists, this insert is a no-op (WHERE guards it) — a follow-up query (not shown, add if needed) should fetch the existing row's id in that case. Simplify by always creating a new conversation client-side per session in Phase 2 and only wire up true multi-turn resumption in a later pass.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.tenant_id, $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.message] }}

nodes.name: Log User Message
nodes.notes: Runs ONCE. 'Load Conversation History' outputs one item per earlier message; without executeOnce this node ran per item and saved the visitor's message N times (0031 cleans up the old copies).

nodes.name: Call Claude
nodes.notes: Single Claude call node used by every turn of the agentic tool loop. Claude API uses x-api-key auth (handled by the anthropicApi credential), not Bearer. 0048: tried up to 3 times (5 s apart, 45 s each). If Claude still can't be reached, the error output goes to "Elliot Unavailable": the client gets a holding reply and the team an escalation, instead of the workflow crashing.

value.contact_id: ={{ (() => { let known = ''; try { known = ($('Identify Visitor').first().json.visitor || {}).contact_id || ''; } catch (e) { known = ''; } return known || $('Extract Tool Call').item.json.tool_input.contact_id; })() }}
value.details: ={{ $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.assistant_mode === 'sales' ? JSON.stringify((({ call_type, agency_name, agents, crm }) => ({ call_type, agency: agency_name, agents, crm }))($('Extract Tool Call').item.json.tool_input)) : '' }}

nodes.name: Execute: Escalate To Human Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: TODO: after importing '24 - Escalate To Human' into n8n, open this node and reselect the workflow from the dropdown -- the value here is a placeholder, not a real workflow ID (24 doesn't exist in your instance until you import it, so its real ID can't be known ahead of time). Same one-time manual step as setting a credential on an imported node.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.tenant_id, $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, $json.final_text || $('Extract Final Text').item.json.final_text] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { conversation_id: $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, reply: $('Use Quick Reply').isExecuted ? $('Use Quick Reply').first().json.final_text : $('Extract Final Text').item.json.final_text } }}
={{ { conversation_id: $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, reply: null, human: true } }}

nodes.name: Respond: Team Member Handling
nodes.notes: A team member is answering this chat from the dashboard. The widget shows their replies by polling the dashboard (/api/widget/messages).

nodes.name: Search Listings
nodes.notes: search_listings() (db/migrations/0027) filters by the tenant id passed in, and only returns available listings.

nodes.name: Log AI Usage
nodes.notes: Adds this reply's Claude token counts to ai_usage_daily (shown as AI cost in the control panel). Passes final_text through for Log Assistant Message. continueOnFail: a usage-logging problem must never block the reply.

parameters.query:
-- Saves the name / email / phone the chat window sends and links them to this
-- conversation (0031). ready = a name plus an email or phone.
-- 0047: $6 = the channel proves who is writing (email, WhatsApp). On the
-- website chat only viewings booked in this conversation are returned.
select identify_chat_visitor($1, $2::uuid, $3, $4, $5, $6::boolean) as visitor;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.tenant_id, $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.contact_name || '', $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.contact_email || '', $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.contact_phone || '', $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.verified === true] }}

nodes.name: Identify Visitor
nodes.notes: Service-role credential: identify_chat_visitor is not callable through the public API.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.assistant_mode === 'sales' || !!$json.visitor && ($json.visitor.ready === true || ($('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.channel === 'whatsapp' && !!$json.visitor.phone) || ($('Merge Tenant Context').first().json.channel === 'email' && !!$json.visitor.email)) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { conversation_id: $('Get or Create Conversation').first().json.conversation_id, reply: "Before we start, please tell us your name and an email address or phone number, so our team can get back to you.", needs_contact: true } }}

nodes.name: Respond: Ask For Details
nodes.notes: No name + email/phone yet: Elliot doesn't answer and the message isn't saved. The chat window shows its details form when needs_contact is true.

nodes.name: Execute: Change Viewing Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Workflow 37. After importing, select '37 - Client Viewing Changes' here. contact_id comes from the conversation, so a client can only change their own bookings.

nodes.name: Quick Reply Check
nodes.notes: Saves a Claude call on plain thank-yous.

parameters.jsCode:
// Same shape as Extract Final Text, no tokens used.
return [{ json: { final_text: $input.first().json.quick_reply, usage_input_tokens: 0, usage_output_tokens: 0 } }];

parameters.query:
-- 0043: a seller or landlord; saves the property on their lead.
select record_valuation_request($1::uuid, nullif($2, '')::uuid, $3::jsonb) as result;

nodes.name: Chat Webhook (Internal)
nodes.notes: Elliot's own workflows (16 and 40 email, 25 WhatsApp) call this one with the internal secret. Only requests that arrive here may say which channel they are and who the client is.

nodes.name: Record Elliot Failure
nodes.notes: Never blocks the reply: if the database is the problem too, the client still gets the holding message.

nodes.name: Trial Ended?
nodes.notes: 0050: the agency's trial has ended. No Claude: one short holding reply a day per conversation, and the client's message is saved for the team.

parameters.query:
-- 0050: saves the client's message (and who they are, if they said) and
-- returns the holding reply, or null if one was sent in the last 24 hours or a
-- team member has taken the conversation over.
select paused_reply($1::uuid, nullif($2, '')::uuid, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) as result;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const r = $json.result || {}; return r.reply ? { conversation_id: r.conversation_id, reply: r.reply, paused: true } : { conversation_id: r.conversation_id, reply: null, human: true, paused: true }; })() }}
